data.title: Rejection of application for medical rehabilitation benefits
data.case_title: Rehabilitation benefits application rejected by pension insurer
data.summary: Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest rejected Lina Mustermeier's application of 13 January 2025 for medical rehabilitation benefits, stating her ability to work is not significantly at risk and outpatient treatment at her place of residence is sufficient (§ 10 SGB VI). An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The pension insurer decided that you do not need medical rehabilitation because outpatient treatment where you live is considered sufficient. If you disagree, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the insurer, or have it recorded in person there; the app shows until when. If you do nothing by then, the rejection becomes final and cannot be challenged further. The letter also notes you may submit a new application any time if your health gets worse. If you want to contest the decision, consider getting advice from a social law advisor or lawyer.

key_facts.label: Application date (Antrag vom)
key_facts.quote: Ihren Antrag vom 13.01.2025 auf Leistungen zur medizinischen Rehabilitation lehnen wir ab.

key_facts.label: Legal basis
key_facts.quote: Nach den vorliegenden Befunden ist Ihre Erwerbsfähigkeit nicht erheblich gefährdet; die ambulante Behandlung an Ihrem Wohnort reicht aus (§ 10 SGB VI).

items.title: File an objection (Widerspruch) against the rejection
items.action: If you disagree with the rejection, submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest, or have it recorded in person at their office, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the rejection becomes final and you can no longer challenge it through an objection.
items.quote: Erheben Sie ihn binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest.

remedy.quote: Gegen die Ablehnung steht Ihnen der Widerspruch zu. Erheben Sie ihn binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest.
